description: Order book for a DeepBook pool: top N price levels per side and cumulative liquidity (base qty and quote notional) within ±X% of mid. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong. Free: 100 calls/day per client, then 0.002 USDC per call on Sui mainnet, prepaid in batches of about 0.01 USDC (the payment-required response gives an exact amount and a payment_token).

levels.description: Price levels to return per side (1-100, default 10)

payment_token.description: Only after the free tier: the private payment_token from the payment-required response; it holds your prepaid calls

payment_tx.description: Only after the free tier: Sui transaction digest of your exact USDC payment for payment_token (see the payment-required response)

pool.description: DeepBook pool name BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC (case-insensitive; '/' or '-' also accepted)

within_pct.description: Depth bands as % distance from mid, e.g. [0.5, 1, 2]

name: get_order_book
title: Order book depth
